description.raw: '''Passive:''' ''Tormented Shadow's'' [[File:Cooldown icon.png|15px|link=Cooldown]] '''current''' cooldown is reduced by 5% of its '''total''' cooldown whenever ''[[File:Morgana Soul Siphon.png|20xpx|border|link=Morgana#Soul Siphon|An icon for Morgana's ability Soul Siphon]] [[Morgana#Soul Siphon|Soul Siphon]]'' triggers. Simultaneous triggers from multiple targets will stack the cooldown reduction.
description.text: Passive: Tormented Shadow's  current cooldown is reduced by 5% of its total cooldown whenever Soul Siphon triggers. Simultaneous triggers from multiple targets will stack the cooldown reduction.

description2.raw: '''Active:''' '''Morgana''' torments the soil at the target location, causing the area to become desecrated for 5 seconds. Enemies within take magic damage on-cast and every 0.5 seconds thereafter, increased by 0% – 100% (based on target's '''missing''' health)[[Category:Debug]]. ''Tormented Shadow'' deals 170% damage against [[File:Monster icon.png|20px|link=Monster|An icon representing the keyword Monster]] [[:Monster|monsters]].
